description: Shorten a .docx, keeping meaning, structure and citations: the whole document to max_words, or only chosen passages (segments), each to its own budget. Saves the result next to the source and returns its path. COSTS CREDITS at 20 per 1,000 words processed (10 minimum) - say so and get agreement first.

max_words.description: Target word count for the whole document (or use segments)

mode.description: rewrite (default) condenses sentences in place; delete removes whole low-value sentences and keeps every other word verbatim

output_path.description: Where to write the result; defaults to beside the source

segments.description: Shorten only these passages, each to its own budget, instead of max_words. A paragraph is the smallest unit: each passage is widened to its whole paragraph.

text.description: A passage to shorten, copied exactly from the document

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait before returning a job id (default 55)

name: condense_document
title: Condense a document
